task.title: Reject duplicate discovered extension IDs
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/596 by making one discovered extension root an unambiguous exact-ID namespace.
acceptance_criteria: Reject the next manifest whose ID exactly equals an earlier ID in sorted discovery order.
Report the preserved ID plus deterministic first and duplicate manifest paths in a typed error.
Keep case, whitespace, and authored ID content significant without normalization.
Fail discovery as a whole and retain metadata-only behavior.

attempts.summary: Established RED for duplicate identity conflicts.
attempts.diagnostic: Discovery returned multiple manifests claiming the same stable ID, leaving later registry lookup ambiguous.
attempts.patch: Added tests for deterministic first and duplicate paths, case and whitespace distinctions, escaped untrusted diagnostics, and source-free typed errors.

attempts.summary: Implemented exact duplicate rejection during sorted discovery.
attempts.diagnostic: Tracking the first path by preserved ID resolves namespace ambiguity without introducing normalization or cross-root precedence policy.
attempts.patch: Added a BTreeMap-backed first-path check, DuplicateId error fields and display behavior, docs, and README milestone evidence.

attempts.summary: Verified and merged the bounded identity slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused tests, pinned verification, exact-head CI, substantive review, and unresolved-thread checks completed successfully.
attempts.patch: Pull request 597 squash-merged as cd66d41424fcca367fd9883d007aef4d27593a7a and closed issue 596.

outcome.summary: Each discovered root now has deterministic exact-ID uniqueness while preserving caller-authored spelling and keeping cross-root policy out of scope.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30170375757 and substantive CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/597

lessons: Stable IDs require uniqueness before constructing a deterministic registry.
Exact comparison is a smaller contract than normalization and avoids silently rewriting caller identity.
Sorted discovery makes both conflict selection and diagnostics reproducible.
Untrusted identifiers must be escaped when rendered in diagnostics.
